notes.text: TRAINING EXAMPLE ONLY. All equipment, stock numbers, CAGE entries, part numbers, SMR assignments, quantities and revision history in this document are fictional. Do not use this publication to requisition parts or maintain operational equipment.

This example applies to model TCB-100A, training configuration A. Source: TM TCB-100A-23, 1 September 2026. That fictional manual has no repair parts listing; this standalone SL-4 supplies the illustrated ordering reference. No alternate configuration is represented.
Blank NSN cells mean no NSN is assigned in this training dataset. Those parts appear in Part II. The ZZ901, ZZ902 and ZZ903 directory entries identify fictional suppliers only.

SMR code PAOZZ is used as illustrative author-entered data. It is not an approved coding determination. A real publication requires verification against the applicable SECNAVINST 4410.23 revision and equipment maintenance concept.

Consolidated equipment quantities include installed parts and the field spares kit. Item 5 totals 14 screws, item 6 totals 10 washers, item 7 totals 10 nuts, item 8 totals 2 gaskets and item 23 totals 3 fuses. Repeated S/A entries intentionally leave the equipment-total cell blank.

Cable is listed in feet (FT); all other repair parts are listed each (EA), except raw sheet stock (SH). Item 3 is fabricated from item 45. Item 34 is assembled from items 35 and 36. Raw sheet stock is not illustrated.

Figure labels identify Part I item numbers; electronic labels also show circuit symbols. The drawings are schematic training illustrations without dimensions. They are not manufacturing, installation or wiring instructions.

MAN marks the example mandatory replacement selections for the gasket and fuse. ECO marks the example economic replacement selections for the two load resistors. Blank indicator cells mean the selection does not apply to that occurrence.
